scope: Lower canonical PredicateTaskList and recursively lifted RPG.GameCore.By* predicate AST nodes into ordered branch IR while preserving SuccessTaskList, FailedTaskList and all raw predicate arguments.

selected_model.binding: A conditional node compiles to a condition AST reference plus explicitly ordered true/false child groups. Each By* node compiles to an opaque-to-evaluation predicate AST node with original source type and arguments.
selected_model.execution: No predicate evaluator is claimed. Target-dependent, modifier-dependent, wave-dependent, stance-dependent and random-dependent conditions remain non-executable until a typed evaluator packet covers them.
selected_model.ordering: Only the selected child branch may execute at runtime; both child lists stay in IR for provenance and compiler diagnostics. KERNEL-EVENT-001 supplies the source-order rule after evaluation.

evidence.support: 45 predicate-AST nodes and 111 PredicateTaskList nodes are recursively lifted with source field paths and child order.
existing predicate/fixpoint foundations are reusable only within their documented scope.

unsupported_cases: truth evaluation of any individual By* type
short-circuit/side-effect behavior beyond explicit child ordering
dsh_implementation_contract: Store predicates as typed AST records with verbatim source type and raw arguments. Never choose SuccessTaskList or FailedTaskList in production until a matching evaluator implementation is supplied.
